spans.s: cīvaraka, nt. (= cīvara, the only form otherwise recorded in Skt., Pali, or Pkt.; no dim. or other perceptible force in suffix -ka), monkʼs robe: ˚kāṇi Divy 〔125.16〕; 〔181.23〕; 〔267.9〕; ˚ka-śatāni, -sahasrāṇi Bbh 〔165.10〕; bhikṣubhir gṛhapati-˚kāṇi … dhārayitavyāni MSV 〔ii.48.19〕. All prose.
cīvara-gopaka, guardian of the (monksʼ) robes: Mvy 〔9065〕; MSV 〔ii.144.15〕.
cīvarika, acc. to Tib. (gos kyi rin du bcas pa) the price of a robe: pātracīvaraṃ sa-cīvara-cīvarikam MSV 〔ii.145.6, 8〕; 〔146.1〕.
